source_record.native_common_basis: Preserve affordable technical change through justified structural work and verification; the means depend on expected future change.
common_cost_and_alternative: Account for structural work, requalification, telemetry, isolation, rehearsal, backup, coexistence, maintenance and delayed beneficial change; do not count the same shared capacity twice.
Compare existing verified seams, a manual controlled release, targeted checks, simulation, a qualified pilot, roll-forward repair, replacement and deliberate retirement as applicable.
A frozen stage, infrequent release or no change may be adequate; no universal deployment cadence or additional approver follows.
Binding constraints and explicitly nontradeable harms limit the choice set independently of ordinary service-budget economics.
source_record.evidence_ceiling: Root analytical arguments from complete selected native bodies and seven own finite controls. Two bounded practitioner-source accesses corroborate mechanisms, not universal causal effects. No deployed experiment, new property, whole synthesis completion or independent acceptance.

common_subconditions.P1: The precise common object and actual receiving use exist.
common_subconditions.P2: The full source and receiver meanings govern, including cheap paths and rejected universal claims.
common_subconditions.P3: The literal separately reasoned partial consequence follows under its guard.
common_subconditions.P4: The stronger-claim witness, residual premises, alternatives and re-entry remain.

source_record.inference: The specifically identified partial capability, evidence or scope constraint is material to the receiving decision. This does not establish complete recovery, a universal cost curve, a deployment cadence, an authority grant or a new control requirement.
source_record.common_source_dependence: Both new practitioner sources belong to the Google SRE ecosystem; no independent causal replication or duplicate credit. Shared artifacts and controls remain shared.
source_record.reentry: Reopen the affected literal direction if configuration, state, population, timing, coupling, exposure, recovery evidence, source version, receiving use, support horizon or authority changes. A failed guard does not establish a global negative; reverse and transitive claims require separate inquiry.

positive_controls.argument: Verified removal of a demonstrated change bottleneck makes a particular alternative feasible or cheaper to test before commitment; the resulting change-cost evidence informs the architecture trade. This is the actual seam and anticipated change, not a general promise from clean code.

The actual change boundary and behavior-preservation evidence identify which implementation correspondence needs renewal and which tested behavior may be reused under a justified equivalence. This is useful reconciliation evidence even though physical deployment identity remains separate.

An identified restructuring with explicit preservation evidence can localize the change and support reuse of unchanged envelope evidence or a narrower requalification question; reduced change friction can make the necessary correction practical.

Targeted verified restructuring can remove a demonstrated obstacle to correcting the control and can preserve identified control behavior while dependent code changes. The contribution is a tractable, checked modification path.

A bounded verified repair to that impediment can make the required transition change practicable and reduce its implementation uncertainty. Its evidence enters the technical portion of the readiness decision.

Verified restructuring of that obstacle can enable a particular fallback, repair or state-reconciliation operation and lower the technical effort of recovery. This is conditional on the actual affected state and interface.
Targeted seams, reduced duplication and verified structural repairs can lower the effort and risk of the named future maintenance action, supporting an actual continuing-support plan.

Observed change seams and bounded preservation evidence supply separate information about edit effort and propagation, allowing control strength to reflect the actual change rather than a phase label.

A verified stable seam permits a concrete late change with no necessary increase in edit or propagation cost; that mechanism and its bounded case challenge calendar lateness as a sufficient universal predictor.
